title: How many openings fit?
hook: An interface can require extra actions before each opening; the action budget is fixed.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to explain the mechanical access limit while keeping real behavioral adaptation outside the model

misconception: Adding access friction automatically measures how much a real person’s distraction will fall.
objective: Explain the mechanical access limit while keeping real behavioral adaptation outside the model.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Action budget fixed; no alternative route, habituation or extra actions; every opening repeats access steps; at most twelve openings.
